batting.name: CM Gautam
batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b M Morkel

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b PP Chawla

batting.name: CJ Anderson
batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b M Morkel

batting.name: Shakib Al Hasan
batting.dismissal: c AT Rayudu b SL Malinga

balls.text: slower this time, the batsman slaps it down to long-off, just for a single
this is a good yorker! Tare wants to send it to the stars, but can only bury it near his toes
quicker delivery, it squares up Pollard and he can only manage a single to cover
he stays on the back foot and cuts it behind point to get off the mark
Narine shows no emotion as he takes out Rohit! The batsman was looking to play the lap shot, he walked right across the stumps, but this zipped off the surface to crash to the top of off
flatter delivery, he looks to hoick it to the leg side but looses his grip on the bat, gets an inside edge to short fine leg
gets away with this full toss as Pollard can only hit to deep midwicket
beautifully bowled, right at the base of off stump and he gets some inswing too, Rohit digs it out to third man
this attempted yorker goes marginally wrong, but Rohit does well to slice this low full toss through cover point.. The deep fielders were all in front
another good delivery, not much room to get under this full delivery, Pollard hammers it down the ground to long on

this is a good yorker! What's happening here? Rohit squeezes it out to point, comes out of the crease, then heads back.. Pollard also comes out of the crease and then heads back.. Gambhir sees the drama in the middle and fires a direct hit at the non-striker's .. Since Umesh was nowhere near, they pick up an extra off the ricochet
he fires a low full toss on off, Pollard is still in no hurry, punches this straight to long off
beauty to finish the over! This was the other one and it beats the outside edge as Rohit attempts a cute little late cut
he wanted a quick single to backward point but is rightly sent back in time
almost a medium pacer's delivery on off, Rohit nudges it to midwicket and calls for a quick couple
flatter and shorter outside off, Polly wanted to cut it fine but finds the man at short third man
bowls a flat offspinner and it stays low, Rohit nudges it through midwicket for a single
he takes it easy, pushes this flighted delivery to long on for a single
moves about in the crease and manages to disturb Shakib. The bowler fires it flat outside off and Rohit cashes in by smashing it to the deep cover boundary off the back foot
works away the fuller delivery to deep midwicket for a single
stays on the back foot to one that stays low, whips it to deep square leg for a couple
he is no hurry, comes forward and defends the tossed up delivery
full and flighted delivery on off, pushed back to the bowler
he makes room and cuts the flatter delivery straight to point, can't find the gap
this is a soft dismissal now! Just when you though Mumbai were making a charge, Anderson plays a tame chip shot straight to midwicket
moves about in the crease and gets a yorker, he gets a leading edge to cover for a single
another length ball, Rohit is announcing his presence now.. Plants his front foot out and launches the length delivery (146 kph) easily over extra cover
now looks to lap it over the keeper's head, but this one is called a wide as it was too far down leg
he brings out his fancy timing to the fore! Length delivery, this is clobbered over long-off easily
he looks to give himself some room but gets a yorker on his toes, manages to squeeze it to wide long-on to bring up the 100 of the team
bowls it full and on the middle and leg line, the batsman pushes it to midwicket

loud appeal for lbw as Anderson is hit on the back pad! It seems headed for the middle and leg stump, but looks like he was saved by where it pitched - Slightly outside leg in my opinion and also going over
he comes forward and dabs it to cover for a quick single

he uses the slog sweep without worrying about the spin on the ball, this was the conventional offspinner, it takes the underedge and rolls between the legs of the keeper, runs almost all the way down to the boundary
plays a pre-meditated sweep to a flatter delivery, manages a single to square leg
that's the other one, not sure if Rohit read that well. he was shaping to cut it, but pulls the bat in at the last moment
bowls it flat and gets it to cut away from Anderson, the batsman goes back and works it away to the leg side
short again from Chawla! he is serving a few treats here, Rohit is not going to miss out on those. He rocks back and crashes it through cover
another one punched to deep cover off the back foot, there is a fielder there now
flatter and shorter now, Anderson gets room and time to smash it along the ground through cover, beats the fielder running in from deep point
flighted delivery, it's sent to the moon! It was full enough for the batsman to get under, he whacks it a long way over the sight screen
slower this time, the batsman can only push it back to the bowler
flatter delivery outside off, it's short enough for Anderson to rock back and punch towards wide long-off, the fielder from long-off does well to cut it off

this is a good ball! Rohit gets another top edge and picks up a four. He has picked up a lot of boundaries like this one in this season. this was a quick short ball, Rohit goes for the hook, but gets an edge over the keeper
no room from Morkel, the batsman dabs it towards cover and calls for a quick single
length delivery across the left-hander, Anderson leaves it alone

No, Yusuf, No! He drops a sitter at wide long-on. He had all the time in the world to take a shower, brush his teeth then take the catch.. But he just allows it to slip through. Rohit got a huge edge as he looked to power this over midwicket. Chris Lynn must be aching
length delivery on off, he comes forward and pushes this to cover. It's definitely not coming on to the bat, even at Morkel's pace
length delivery outside off, the batsman looks to steer it to third man but gets beaten.. Rohit feels it stays low, it didn't
spins in and stays very low, Anderson does well to get some bat on it.. It was shaping for an lbw

the sagging run scoring takes its first victim! Rayudu comes down the pitch to force the pace, wanted to smash it over long-on but doesn't get hold of it - the ball has been stopping in the pitch all day. This one is safely taken at long-on
this is poor, lot of width provided and Rayudu crashes it in front of square off the back foot
pushes at it away from the body and picks up a single to point, and again it stops a touch on the surface
some width this time but Rohit cuts it straight to point
he comes down the pitch and punches this back past the bowler, it was not very far from the right hand.. The ball stuck in the pitch and the batsman played it back in the air
looks to heave this to the leg side but realises this is not bouncing much, changes his shot to a push to deep midwicket
keeps coming in with the arm, the batsman can only punch it back to the bowler
stays in the crease and works this one away to deep midwicket for a single
flatter delivery, Rohit can't get it away, pushes it back to the bowler
again, it stays a touch low, it hits the pads and rolls close towards the keeper
fires this one on the pads, again, it stays low.. Rohit squeezes it out back towards the bowler
tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and drives it down to deep extra cover
gets some turn by bowling it slower, the batsman pushes it back down the pitch
flatter delivery on the stumps, the batsman pushes it to long on for a single
this is the googly, but it is short enough for Rohit to rock back and punch it to deep cover
dances down the pitch but doesn't get hold of this flighted delivery, drives it down to long on
he stays in the crease and pushes this softly in the gap at deep midwicket for a quick couple
tossed up outside off but Rayudu drags it from there to deep midwicket with an agricultural sweep
stays on the back foot and punches it to deep point for a single
finds the gap at backward point this time.. He does it better than what Rohit did in the last ball
flatter and shorter outside off, the batsman cuts it down to short third man for a single
another one that stays very low, Rayudu lucky again as it's outside off
gets some turn in to the batsman, easily punched to wide long-on for a single. Oh no, Manish charges in and is not able to pick up the ball, allows an extra

he is very very lucky here! This one is similar to that underground delivery bowled by Shakib.. Rayudu was lucky that this was just outside the line of off, he gets beaten and crouches down on the pitch..
bowls the top spinner, Rohit goes deep in the crease and punches it to deep cover
flatter from the bowler, Rohit defends it off the front foot
lots of air again from Chawla, Rayudu was out of the crease, makes it a half-volley and eases it to long off
he waits on the back foot and punches the flatter delivery to deep midwicket
lots of loop on this one, the batsman looks to drive it to off but gets it off the toe, straight to cover
attempts a slower delivery, the batsman waits on the back foot before nudging it to deep square leg
waits in the crease and pushes the length delivery to cover
he comes forward and pushes the length delivery softly to long-on for a single
length delivery on off, the batsman pushes it to cover. It probably stayed a touch low as it hit the toe of the bat
smartly played from Rayudu! He uses his feet, moves slightly to the leg side to give himself some room and just drives it over mid-off for another boundary
he fires this on the off stump line, the batsman stays in the crease and defends
skips down the pitch and eases it to long-off for another single. A sedate start for Mumbai here.
uses his feet to get to the pitch of the delivery and drives it down to long-off to get off the mark
comes forward and punches this to the left of Shakib
still slower from Shakib, the batsman pushes it to cover
tossed up and slow at 79.9 kph, the batsman waits and defends it to off

this one goes below the radar! Shakib bowls these balls from time to time.. It's the arm-ball, keeps coming in and stays mighty low. Simmons was aiming for the sight screen - he was out of the crease and gave it a proper swing, but the bat just met thin air and the ball crashed low into the leg stump. He makes amends for that dropped catch
wide outside off and Rayudu looks to cut it through backward point, but is not able to beat the fielder
flatter delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it off the back foot

Shakib gets there at deep square leg but drops it! It was a big top-edge as the batsman went for a sweep, and Shakib did very well to run in from deep midwicket, got both hands to it, but couldn't hold on
this is the other one now, but Rayudu spots it and defends it to point
fires it flat on off, the batsman comes forward and defends to off
tosses it up on off stump, Simmons leans forward and picks up a single to long on
this time he plays it in front of the wicket, driving the tossed up delivery to wide mid-off for a single
another sweep and another one heads to the boundary, this one is finer, beats the short third man fielder
slows it down and follows the batsman who was making room, Simmons defends
now back to the sweep shot! it's not hit hard, just controlled well enough to pierce the gap at backward square leg
he moves to the leg side, gets a quick flat delivery on the stumps and punches it back to the bowler
tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman sweeps it from there to square leg
stays calm and defends the follow up delivery to point
superb hit! This carries all the way. Rayudu is carrying his from from the last game, he comes down the pitch and lofts the length delivery over mid-on effortlessly
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman defends it to cover
the short one is followed by a 145 kph yorker, the batsman wanted to dig it out down the ground but gets an inside edge to deep square leg
smart reply! This is a short delivery and the batsman looks to flat-bat back down the ground but doesn't make any contact. But that's too high, has been called a wide
length delivery on off, the batsman dabs it to cover for a quick single, but Morkel has overstepped here
wrong line, this is down the leg side and is an easy call for the umpire

straight to cover! Gautam was not very comfortable against the pace of Morkel, so this time he tries to force it. He moves to the leg side and tries to drive it on the up through covers, but is not able to keep it down. Good low catch by Surya
short of length outside off, the batsman stayed rooted to the crease and has a poke at that, misses
looks to hoick it over midwicket but doesn't get much timing, Tendo chases it down from square leg
he makes room and whacks the length delivery to the right of mid-off, Gambhir gets a hand to it, but can't stop it cleanly
goes back to the line outside off, Gautam takes a step forward and punches it to cover, picks up a single as the fielder doesn't stop it cleanly
poor delivery! He follows up two good deliveries with a leg side length delivery, it is helped on it's way to the fine-leg boundary
this one holds it line to beat the outside edge! Comes in the air and just nips away from a length, beating Gautam's forward push
bowls it full with a bit of shape, the batsman leans forward and drives it straight to cover point
stays in the crease and hops to defend the length delivery down the pitch
he stays on the back foot and defends the length delivery to off
down the leg side, it flies past the pads and the keeper doesn't collect it cleanly, allowing an extra run
gets some away movement from a line wide outside off, the batsman comes forward and lets it go through
peach of a delivery! Although, Gautam just plays inside the line of this rising length delivery, flies past the shoulder of the bat
slightly drifting on to the pads and Simmons, hopping on his toes, clips it to fine leg. That actually went off the thigh pad
on target first ball! Back of length and honing in on off, the batsman defends off the back foot
Yusuf Pathan hits the winning runs to celebrate his 100th match. Short ball, pulled hard.

another slower delivery and Shakib lifts it straight up in the air, easy catch by Rayudu who comes running in from long-on. He was looking for the big finish (he has done that in the past, against Nepal recently), but  is outfoxed by Malinga this time
slower delivery outside off, Shakib wanted to crash it over extra cover but is beaten
fires it full on the toes, but Shakib gets his feet out of the way and flicks it to deep midwicket for a couple
slides down the leg side but not given a wide. Yusuf is again not impressed
he looks for the big one, but can only get it as far as mid-on as this hits the toe of the bat
waits an extra bit and punches it in the air past the non-striker for a single
fuller delivery, Shakib powers it down to long off for another single
length delivery, he punches it on the up to long off for a single
shorter and on the pads, Yusuf picks up the boundary as he drags it behind square on the leg side. Tare dives, but can't keep it in
that's a drop! Yusuf powers the low full toss back to Malinga who was a little slow to react to it as it came towards his face.. it actually ricochets towards cover, the fielder was not too far
finally the yorker makes an appearance, Shakib flicks it behind square easily
short ball again, this time it is outside off and Shakib cuts it over point easily to pick up another boundary
short ball, the batsman looks to pull, then pulls out of line, looks to the umpire to see if this is a wide, but this flew over the leg stump
short ball, but this comes at an easy pace, Yusuf plays an upper cut to third man
this is down the leg side and Yusuf manages to tickle it past the diving wicketkeeper
Gautam is enthusiastic behind the wicket and appeals for a caught behind, but this was a wide down the leg side.. Yusuf gives him a stare
middle stump takes a beating! Uthappa was staying still while playing those smooth drives, but this time he moves to the leg side to make room and just plainly misses this one..
length delivery outside off, Yusuf smashes it - or at least that was the intention - as this trickles to deep point
this is on the pads and he tucks it to deep midwicket easily
on the pads, the batsman pushes it to midwicket softly for a single
oh this is even prettier! This is not as full as the last one, but just a straight-batted drive over extra cover.. It's flat, it's long, it's over the boundary
slower delivery, this is beautifully punched over wide long-off! He doesn't try to do fancy things, always just plays these drives with the straightest of bats.. Supreme hit
slower and tossed up, Uthappa punches this down to long on
reverse sweep! He does play this well, goes almost outside off and drags it from leg stump for a couple
quicker delivery this time and it was very low too.. Had he missed, he was going to be plumb.. But he manages to get some bat and hits it to square leg for his opening run
loopy delivery on off, the batsman dabs it to cover and wants to run to the other end, but sent back
bowls a slower one outside off, the batsman defends it to the off

another inside edge, another wicket! That's what Mumbai need - a few that stay low. This one was bowled at a snail's pace, Pandey goes on the back foot to cut, but this one just doesn't rise.. He chops it on to his leg stump
slower delivery outside off, Pandey stretches out and pushes it to wide mid-off for a single
he is driving on the highway, steers the length delivery down to third man
short ball outside off, it comes off the pitch like this is Roland Garros, Manish Pandey plays a over the shoulder top spin shot down the ground for a single
back of length delivery, this is dabbed behind point for another easy single. It's all too easy, life is easy
poor delivery, it's a low full toss outside off and Uthappa has seen enough balls today, he slices it past point
he looks to punch the length delivery on the up, but gets an inside edge to midwicket
looks to find that tiny gap at backward point, but unfortunately he can't
slower from Ojha, the batsman pushes it to cover again
he comes out of the crease and punches the flatter delivery to cover
almost gets beaten by the quicker one but manages to push it to long off for a single
waits in the back foot and crashes it off the back foot, but Pollard cuts it off at wide long off
looks to chop it through point, but can't beat Simmons there
length delivery on the stumps, Robin keeps stealing singles, this time with a dab towards point
slower length delivery on the stumps, Uthappa dabs it softly to deep midwicket and calls for a couple
another short of length delivery on the pads, Pandey drags it to deep midwicket again
short of length, sits up nicely outside off and Pandey hammers it to deep midwicket for a couple
back of length delivery on the stumps, Robin drops it by the stumps and calls for a single early
starts off with a length delivery outside off, the batsman lets it go through
another single, this time he pushes it to cover point for a single
looks for the yorker, easily flicked away to deep midwicket
length delivery outside off, Uthappa brings up yet another fifty as he punches it to deep cover
that stays very very low! He brings his bat down just in time and manages to get an outside edge for a boundary..Mumbai lost a wicket to that kind of ball.. Simmons it was
comes slow of the surface again, tis time Pandey punches it to deep cover
short of length delivery that gets stuck in the pitch, Pandey chips it to deep midwicket. He wasn't in control of that shot
slower and tossed up on off, Pandey pushes it easily to long on
attempts the doosra, Pandey can't get it away, defends it back down the pitch
did that hit something? Looks like it, probably flicked the pad on its way to the keeper
he comes forward and drives it to long off
this almost went into the hands of short third-man! Bhajji is not impressed with Bumrah, who dives forward but doesn't get his body behind the ball. Uthappa played a sweep to the leg-sidish delivery
slower and heading to the off stump, Pandey goes back and nudges it behind square leg for a single
he finds the boundary by making some room and cutting it behind point
comes down the pitch and pushes the flatter delivery to long-on, it was in the air as it crossed the non-striker
solidly comes forward and defends it back to the bowler
tosses it up outside off, the batsman reaches out and drives it to deep cover
teasing flighted delivery, Pandey pushes it to long off
loopy delivery outside off, he punches it down to long off for an easy single
spins in from outside off to hit the pads, but this was turning down leg
he goes down on his knee and paddles the ball from outside off down to deep backward square leg, it was in the air for a while
lots of flight on this one, Pandey comes forward and drives it down to long off
flatter and quicker outside off, the batsman defends it off the back foot
big spin greets Pandey, but it spins too far down the leg side. Oh, they are checking for the stumping.. Pandey never lifted his foot. A bit unnecessary

he chops it on! Gambhir has been looking to play that short for a while, he goes back to play it again, expecting the ball to turn away, but this one doesn't...he gets a thick inside edge and shatters his stumps
gets big turn and the batsman lets it go as it's wide
he goes back and punches this flatter delivery straight to cover
and again! He cuts it straight to short third man, Robin scoots for a quick one this time, brings the 50 of the stand
shorter and flatter outside off, Gambhir misses out as he chops this straight to short third man
lots of air on this one, Gambhir comes out of the crease but as the ball spins in, he gets an inside edge down to fine leg
slower and tossed up outside off, Robin dabs it to short third man for a quick single
he skips out of the crease and whips the turning delivery to square leg.. Malinga makes a half-stop but can't prevent the single
another of those outswingers, the batsman defends it to cover point

now he gets an outside edge, but this is a cruel world if you are bowler.. There is no slip in place and the third-man is square..Not that Ojha would have stopped it ... Robin lets Malinga know that he is struggling by tapping his shoulder
and again, this movement is troubling Robin. He wanted to dab this to the leg side but gets a leading edge to cover
superb outswinger! How does he get this much movement? It pitches on a length on off, then completely squares up Robin, beating the outside edge by a long way
length delivery outside off, the batsman dabs it to point. Gambhir wants a single, but is rightly sent back
attempts the slower one, but this one slips down the leg side
bowls length on off, this swings a touch away too. Robin gets squared up in his defence
he bends down on his knee early and sweeps this one comfortably to deep square leg for a couple
comes forward and dabs the length delivery to cover for a quick single
quicker one outside off, he cuts it straight to point
this is clean hitting from Robin! He gets the fuller length delivery and again, he comes forward to play a clean straight drive, sending it all the way over long on
he waits on the back foot and chops the flatter delivery straight to point
flatter delivery, the batsman has to change to defence after coming out of the crease..
he misses out as he flicks the low full toss straight to midwicket
he keeps going straight! This is not that full but Robin comes forward and chips it back over the bowler's head
that has been cracked off the front foot! I heard the thud of the bat all the way in Mumbai! It was on a length and Robin comes to the front foot to smash it past the bowler
stays on the back foot and steers the length delivery down to third man
now he is beaten by the pace and bounce on this short of length delivery! He wanted to cut it over point but makes no connection
the inside edge saves Gambhir there! The batsman was rooted to the crease and pushing at the length ball away from his body
now Robin uses his feet and although he is not to the pitch of the ball, he goes ahead with his chip shot, just manages to beat Malinga's leap at mid-off
comes out of the crease and looks to play this tossed up delivery inside out, but gets an inside edge to mid on
waits on the back foot and punches the flatter delivery straight to cover
he looks to come out of the crease, Bhajji shortens his length and Robin responds by chopping it straight to short third-man.. Another misfield, now by Tare, it gives them a single
he waits on the back foot and guides the flatter delivery to short third man for a quick single, Ojha doesn't collect the ball cleanly
squares up the batsman with a flatter delivery, Robin gets an outside edge to short third man
on the pads, not a good finish by Bumrah. Gambhir tickles it fine on the leg side and gets a boundary
he moves to the leg side and looks to carve it over the infield, but this takes off from back of length and beats the bat
back of length and on the stumps, Gambhir stays back and drops it down by his feet
big inswing from wide of the crease, hits the batsman high up on the bat as he looks to nudge it to the leg side, they steal a single to midwicket
back of length delivery on off, Uthappa gets on top of that and defends it to point
bowls length on the pads, it tickles fine on the leg side off the thigh pad
superb yorker on the toes! The same ball hit Gambhir's leg stump as he fell over, but now he is back in form, a bit more self-assured, he stays upright and flicks it to fine leg
another away-going length delivery, the batsman comes forward and guides it to third man
another one wide outside off, it keeps going away from the bat and flies past the outside edge
length delivery outside off, beats the bat and stays low, reaches the keeper on the bounce
this is superbly timed through midwicket! Another attempted yorker and it marginally dropped short of the correct length.. Robin was waiting, he stays still and whips this through the gap
fires in a yorker at the base of off, Uthappa pushes it to cover
